name: TC-03-employee-labor
description: TC-03.2: Employee & Labor Setup — Create employees and labor records with trade assignments

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.2 — Employee List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Employee. Employees are linked to users, sites, and departments. They serve as requestors, approvers, and technicians across the system.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.2 — New Employee
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create an employee record. Link the employee to a user account, site, and department.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.2 — Fill Employee Name
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E John Smith" into the Employee Name field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.2 — Employee Created
doc_metadata.caption: The employee record is created with an auto-generated ID (e.g., EMP-00001). The employee can now be assigned to maintenance requests, work orders, and labor records.

doc_metadata.title: TC-03.2 — Employee Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The employee record shows name, linked user, site, department, and trade. Employees serve as the bridge between user accounts and operational entities.
